title: Past Simple (Irregular Verbs)
summary: Irregular verbs change their form completely in the past (e.g., go -> went).
explanation: Irregular verbs do not follow the -ed rule; their past form must be memorized.
rules: Learn special past forms (e.g., go -> went, see -> saw).

common_error_explanations.err_past_irreg_1: Do not add -ed to irregular verbs.
